headlines.title: Supreme Court blocks Missouri’s attempt to use newly drawn GOP congressional map
headlines.description: WASHINGTON — The U.S. Supreme Court on Thursday blocked an attempt by a Republican state official in Missouri to use a newly drawn GOP congressional map for this year’s elections.

headlines.title: Vance calls on battleground state Republicans to ‘nationalize’ the midterms
headlines.description: Vice President JD Vance urged Republicans from several battleground states Thursday to “nationalize” their midterm elections this fall.

headlines.title: Jimmy Kimmel says show won’t air James Talarico interview on TV, citing FCC threats
headlines.description: Jimmy Kimmel announced on Wednesday night that his show would not air his upcoming interview with Texas’ Democratic Senate candidate James Talarico on television, citing the Trump administration’s threats against ABC.

headlines.title: Rhode Island Gov. Dan McKee loses Democratic primary to businesswoman Helena Foulkes
headlines.description: NBC News projects that Foulkes won the Democratic nomination in the blue state, making McKee the first governor to fall in a primary in eight years.

headlines.title: ‘We felt defeated’: Lindsay Clancy juror provides new details about the lone holdout
headlines.description: A juror in Lindsay Clancy’s murder trial provided new details Thursday about the lone holdout on the panel, including that he acted out the killings on a water bottle during deliberations.

headlines.title: Oil prices surge to $107 for the first time since May as bond yields jump
headlines.description: The price of oil surged again, with Brent crude surpassing $107 per barrel for the first time since May as markets brace for a long U.S. war with Iran.

headlines.title: Spice Girls fans feel duped after social media tease wasn’t for tour, but a music re-release
headlines.description: Spice Girls fans are telling you what they want — what they really, really want — and it’s a tour that they aren’t getting any time soon.

headlines.title: Hurricane carves path of destruction in Hawaii
headlines.description: More than 80% of customers are without power on the island of Kauai after Hurricane Lowell left a path of destruction. NBC News’ Liz Kreutz is in the storm zone tonight.

headlines.title: Halloween Chocolatey Eyeballs Candy Recalled Over Allergy Risks
headlines.description: New Jersey candy company Little Temptations has recalled their popular “chocolatey eyeballs” because of undeclared milk allergens. The candy is sold at major retailers including Marshalls, TJ Maxx, and Home Goods in 13 states.

headlines.title: Nicolás Maduro’s wife seeks home detention ahead of trial citing ‘serious’ heart condition
headlines.description: The wife of former Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro, Cilia Flores, asked a federal judge late Wednesday to release her from jail pending trial, citing a “serious” heart condition.

headlines.title: Florida attorney general sues Netflix over ‘bait-and-switch’ on privacy for kids
headlines.description: Florida’s attorney general filed a sweeping lawsuit against Netflix, accusing the streaming giant of misleading consumers about its data collection practices.
